title: Benchmark runtime snapshot policy and driver compatibility
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Establish a deterministic runtime snapshot and driver compatibility policy for our end-to-end benchmarking and load-testing harnesses. The goal is to eliminate unexplained variance in tokens/sec and p95 latency signals caused by implicit environment drift (GPU drivers, CUDA minor versions, base images, and runner-side dependencies). This ticket covers: 1) formalizing a snapshot format for CI/bench jobs that pins driver/CUDA/docker image layers and runner versions; 2) integrating snapshot validation into the benchmark CI gate; 3) adding metadata to benchmark outputs so regression detection correlates with environment changes.
acceptance_criteria: Bench CI jobs produce a signed runtime snapshot file that lists kernel drivers, CUDA minor version, pinned base image digest, runner commit SHA, and kernel flags
Snapshot is uploaded as an artifact and surfaced in benchmark dashboards alongside performance traces
CI rejects benchmark jobs that run against non-approved snapshots unless explicitly marked experimental
Regression alerting groups by snapshot metadata so perf regressions can be attributed to code vs environment
Documented rollout plan and runbook for updating approved snapshots with clear rollback steps
plan: Design snapshot schema and minimal fields required for reproducibility
Add snapshot capture stage to benchmark runner: gather nvidia-smi, cuobjdump version, docker image digests, kernel modules, and runner git SHA
Create a lightweight validator service (CI job) that checks snapshots against an approved matrix stored in the performance-infra repo
Extend benchmark result schema to include snapshot metadata and attach to existing time-series metrics (tokens/sec, p95) in Datadog/Prometheus
Modify regression detector to namespace alerts by snapshot hash and add a suppression window when snapshot transitions are intentional
Work with infra to agree on a cadence for refreshing the approved snapshot matrix and a change approval flow
Add docs, PR template, and a migration plan for existing nightly benchmarks
